👤 Accounts & Saves

👁 Public Visibility

Checked = people on the public copies can see it. Changes save instantly. They reach the public by exporting a new Public file or an Update file (🔄) after you change them. This panel never shows up on public copies.

📖 Guide

In-game menu: press your toggle key (default Tab or gamepad Select) to show/hide the floating controls.

Music: pick an Audio Folder once (Chrome/Edge) and it is remembered.

Controls: keyboard (arrows or WASD, Enter, Esc) and any controller (Xbox, PlayStation, Switch, generic) both work everywhere, including Settings. Controller: D-pad moves between items, the left stick moves a highlighter and A/Cross clicks the highlighted item (or launches the highlighted game), the right stick scrolls, B/Circle goes back, Start opens Settings, bumpers change track. Rebind every key and button in ⚙ Settings.

In a game: the controller is sent to the game as arrow keys + WASD (stick/D-pad), Space (A/RT), X (B), Z (X), C (Y), Q/E (bumpers), Enter (Start). Games that read the Gamepad API themselves also get the controller, and the right stick moves a mouse pointer (RT or R3 clicks) for mouse-only games. Music and hub buttons stay off until you open the menu with Tab / Select. Change the keys with ⚙ Settings → Library → 🎮 Controller → keys mapping, or turn it off under Settings → Controller.

Accounts & saves: make an account on the sign-in screen (PIN optional) or play as guest. Every uploaded game saves into your account on this device. To move to another device use 👤 Account → Download account file (or cloud sync if the host set one up). Web-link games keep saves on their own site.

Sharing: System Tools → Export Single File gives you ONE .html with everything inside. Send it; they just open it. Public files can be uploaded to GitHub Pages; drop mivyx-update-1.html, -2.html… next to it to update it. Public copies have a 📥 Download for offline play button.

State files (.txt): when you close or refresh the tab with new progress, a .txt copy of your saves downloads by itself. If the browser data is ever wiped, use 👤 Account → 📥 Manual Load and pick that file. Guests are not exported; a guest can tap 💾 Make a real account to keep their progress.
